note: Hand-verified sizeBox picks: required volume computed by hand from Table 314.16(B)(1) (see box-fill.json note for the allowance list), then compared against the ascending Table 314.16(A) volumes — the pick is the first box (within the shape filter) whose volume covers the requirement.
